title: No, I Think You've Covered Everything, Explained
subtitle: Signy Okpara on the last question of the job interview and what a selection panel does with it
summary: A research explainer from the School of Continuous Improvement on Signy Okpara's doctoral thesis about the question a job candidate is invited to ask at the end of an interview. It follows the invitation from 412 recorded interviews through the panellists' sealed scores, the panels' answers and a trial in which the question was scored, and closes on the Candidate Question Standard the University has adopted. Okpara describes the work in her own words.
topic: A research explainer of the doctoral thesis on the last question of a job interview, following the invitation to ask through 412 recorded interviews, 764 pairs of sealed scores, the panels' answers and a four-arm field trial, to the University's Candidate Question Standard
